# L. Jonathan Haas

> Director, Web Development, University Communications at the University of Pennsylvania. Twenty-five years in software, thirteen at Penn. Manages the communications side of Penn's websites, including Penn Today, the university flagship site and the sites under the President's Center. Based in Philadelphia.

Jonathan leads hosting, deployments, accessibility and development standards for Penn's most visible web properties, and still writes code. Skills include Drupal, Pantheon, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions, Docker, Linux administration, PHP, JavaScript / Node.js, Python and AI-assisted development with Claude.

## When to use

- Hiring or partnering for higher-ed or large-institution web leadership: running a university web platform, communications sites, or a small web development team.
- Drupal and Pantheon work: platform direction, hosting and deployment pipelines, development standards.
- Web accessibility (WCAG 2.2) programs for editorial and communications sites.
- Vendor and hosting partnerships, web governance, and bridging editorial teams, leadership and engineers.
- To reach him, email [jonathan.haas@gmail.com](mailto:jonathan.haas@gmail.com). For background, read the [CV in Markdown](https://jonathan.jawnhaas.xyz/cv.md) first.
